reason: As the BSA officer, B lets me step one fictional member from due to decided in the first screen and see the spreadsheet it replaces change alongside, with every number internally consistent and labelled fictional. It also puts 'your compliance officer makes every risk decision' and the pilot status beside the CTA. A is honest and well written but shows a static file whose entries fall below the first screen on a phone, and it has no mobile navigation. A page that also answered the CEO's and the examiner's vendor-risk questions would change my view only if it were A.
